name: jsettlers-match
purpose: Measured external benchmark: the served policy (planner_offer_accept) alone vs three built-in JSettlers2 robots, classic 4-player base game (Jerry 2026-11-07: 'Yes do A').
analysis: Win share of our bot (fair share .25) with a Wilson 95% interval over games; reported by our seat and by our position after the first player (both chosen by the server, not controllable). Validity: 0 bridge errors and every game completed; fallbacks (our move rejected or impossible, JSettlers' own brain substitutes) are reported by type, and the win share is also reported on games with no fallback. Retirement rule as for Catanatron: retire JSettlers' robot as a benchmark if our win share >= .50 with the 95% lower bound > .40; otherwise keep it.
limitations: JSettlers' server RNG (dice, board, dev deck, first player) is unseeded (SOCGame uses new Random()); seeding it would need a JSettlers source patch, which we do not make. Each game's board id, our seat and position are recorded instead; our policy is seeded. The JSettlers server is authoritative for these games; our engine only chooses moves (see tools/jsettlers/README.md for the rules differences the bridge handles). Opponents are JSettlers' default built-in robot (fast pause); a single opponent type, not a ladder.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before any measured game, after the 8-game smoke (2 runs: 0 bridge errors, 0 fallbacks). Runs only after Codex reviews the bridge (board #1 row). Local Mac mini; ~9 s per game.
